content: {"episode_id":"ep-05103","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was ordered for a patient with a history of recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope (R55), raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia. Clinical evaluation identified paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1) as potential etiologies for these intermittent symptoms. The monitor is required to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management, and no shorter-duration recording can capture these intermittent events. We therefore request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial for this medically necessary service."}
